title: Dependency fetched over the unauthenticated git protocol
description: package.json declares a dependency URL that uses the `git://` protocol. The git protocol carries no transport authentication for the fetched objects, so a network attacker can substitute the tree the install compiles.
remediation: Fetch over `git+https://` with a commit sha, or publish the package to the registry.
limitation: It matches a dependency URL that uses the `git://` protocol in the parsed package.json; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
